title: Wondering when extern hiring actually happens? (format C, photo cover)

brief.problem: Students don't know when extern hiring happens, so they look too late or give up after one quiet week.
hooks: wondering when extern hiring actually happens?
is it too late to apply for an externship?
when do externship postings actually open?
brief.why: Photo cover with a question hook, as requested. 'When is extern hiring season, and are applications open now?' is the first recurring question in the research (P020, P029). Slides answer it honestly: each posting has its own dates, the program matches twice a year (October, February), a long-term care pilot is planned (labelled planned), and a simple routine so they don't miss postings. Rejected: 'too late' and 'missed extern season?' imply a season we can't confirm for every hospital.
brief.payoff: The reader knows there isn't one season for every hospital, the two program matching rounds, what's planned next, and a routine for not missing postings.

slides.title: wondering when extern hiring actually happens?
it's not one season for every hospital
slides.body: each posting has its own dates, and some don't list a closing date at all.

slides.label: extern notes 📝
slides.title: the program matches twice a year
slides.body: Ontario Health says students are matched with hospitals in October and February through the Enhanced Extern Program.

slides.title: long-term care is next (planned)
slides.body: Ontario Health plans a new extern pilot in long-term care for 2026/27. planned, not open yet.

slides.title: how not to miss postings
slides.body: check every couple of weeks, write down each closing date the day you find it, and keep your certification and references ready.

slides.title: looking for extern postings in ontario?
slides.body: ontarioexterns.ca lists them with closing dates, checked on each hospital's own careers page.

facts.claim: Through the program, students are matched with hospitals twice a year, in October and February. This describes the program, not every posting.
facts.quote: Each year, students are matched with hospitals twice – once in October and again in February

facts.claim: Ontario Health says it will be working with the Ministry of Long-Term Care to launch a new extern pilot program in long-term care in 2026/27. Planned, not open.
facts.quote: will be working with the Ministry of Long-Term Care to launch a new extern pilot program in long-term care in 2026/27

caption.text:
wondering when extern hiring actually happens? 👇

postings open and close on their own dates. through Ontario Health’s Enhanced Extern Program, students are matched with hospitals twice a year, in October and February, and Ontario Health says a long-term care extern pilot is planned for 2026/27 (planned, not open).

when did you start looking?

ontarioexterns.ca is an independent tracker of Ontario extern postings, checked on hospitals’ own career pages. Not affiliated with any hospital.
